project_prior_work.distinction: Nine Lf occurrences in four repeated forms on four physical leaves; 72 leaf-preserving label assignments concern image-pair support, not label-to-body exact-frequency calibration.
N=12 copy-token construction and identity matrix can agree without semantics; not a calibrated weak-effect leaf-bag test.

Two leaves, twelve name positions each, four fixed text-regime×leaf combinations, 576 cells/48 phases. Whole-name contiguous recurrence and conservative missing bounds, not Voynich leaf conditional randomization or a permutation p-value.

verified_old_design.preserved: Page/leaf, length, opportunity and donor geometry.
verified_old_design.not_preserved: Real heavy-tailed token frequencies, actual query-word repetition dependence, cross-leaf copying/topic correlation.
verified_old_design.saved_caution: Synthetic copy mechanism diagnostic only; neither manuscript p-values nor semantic power estimates.

calibration_audit.leaf_controls_checks: Exact arithmetic toy plus independent complete enumeration; checks computation, not weak-effect detection or correct null calibration.
calibration_audit.gap_status: No corresponding executed near-observed-effect power curve or realistic-frequency local-copy/no-object-semantics calibration found in this bounded search. This is a documented searched-scope gap, not a project-wide proof of absence.
recommended_W8_focus: Retain existing actual data and whole-leaf estimator; design realistic-frequency/repeated-label calibration before new empirical claims.
Use a fixed weak-association gradient with null and local-copy confound mechanisms; distinguish detection of form concentration from semantic discrimination.
Use the original seven models/six increments and both versions; publish negative calibration and nonexchangeability results; no score-based retuning.

input_schema.repetition: Occurrences remain individual label records; shared word identities and leaf grouping reconstructable without discarding repeats. Separate repeated-label cluster files explicitly preserve shared occurrences.
input_schema.scope_exclusions: Only predeclared L/P subtypes; circular/radial text and multiword/uncertain labels excluded by old contract. No new Currier field was added; H/I/Q are available.

repeated_label_structure.scope: Historical text/locator records only read here; no image review or new features.

nonexchangeability_and_interpretation_co: 整叶重分配保留原始词形、正文词频、标签频数和叶内依赖，但跨叶顺序、同主题、邻叶复制及共同模板依赖没有被消除。H/I/Q条件不证明可交换性。
主H1/P跨O与S册帖；同册帖严格对照已做，仍不是历史随机分配。叶号差只是代理。
保留标签亚型组成不等：f78只有Lt、f80只有Ln，医药叶可能只有Lf或Lf+Lc。共同长度不等于相同对象角色。
原同页估计与后续同叶估计的单位、权重和支持不同，不能将两个差值相减称趋势或新增效应。
机会为零、未知或混合H/I、无共同长度与单叶组属于资格不足，不得填零；13叶不是全文代表样本。
跨叶相同标签共享身份不变；大量出现位置不能成为独立样本。整袋置换不是逐标签独立重抽。
两版来自同一手稿；EVA长度、词界、标签范围和IVTFF布局类型是转写约定，不是已认证语词或对象。
原input页级H/I/Q沿用源；@混手页排除，非完整Davis逐行书手重建；不能把H=1..5视为毫无误差的实际作者身份。
保留固定点、包括恒等排列；旧均值不是纯错页均值。六模型同步最大增量只对应原整体全局零假设，不是六个单独强FWER结论。
药材类与浴疗类必须全保留；不能为增强差异择类别、长度、字对、叶或标签词。
